::: {#exm-congruence}
#### Congruences

- By @sol-minus-eight,
  $23 \equiv 8 \pmod{5}$, $38 \equiv 8 \pmod{5}$ and $-7 \equiv 8 \pmod{5}$,
  but $50 \not\equiv 8 \pmod{5}$.
- A 24-hour clock that reads $19$ shows the same hour as a 12-hour clock that reads $7$,
  and $19 \equiv 7 \pmod{12}$, because $19 - 7 = 12 = 12 \cd 1$.

:::
